author: Thefenix75
quote: The greatest remake of all time for the greatest video game of all time. A version that preserves everything that made the original special while introducing improvements that make the experience even better: 60 FPS, more detailed textures and clothing for Link, smoother combat, and many other refinements. An absolute masterpiece. Outstanding work.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Thefenix75
quote:
In my opinion, this is a game that has barely evolved in any meaningful way. Beyond improved graphics, I don't see any significant advancements that justify the many years of development. Considering how much time Rockstar had to work on this game, the final result is a disappointment.

On top of that, we're stuck with a 30 FPS limitation, not to mention the numerous bugs. Honestly, I find it ridiculous that this game received a 99 on Metacritic. Are we really looking at a masterpiece, or were there commercial interests and backroom deals involved with Rockstar?
